decisions.statement: A function or an event the list does not name is left out.
An object the list names carries in the objects above.
An excluded object is left out however the object was reached.
An enum named in a taken signature is taken too.
A name the dump does not describe is passed over rather than refused.
The tokens taken keep the order the dump described.

definition: the tokens an opt-in list picks out of a dump, with what those tokens reach
